$comment: Committed, read-only snapshot of release/changelog state consumed by scripts/lib/check-changelog-release-drift.mjs (a2a-nexus#1501). The checker is OFFLINE (no network, no git introspection): it reads only this file plus CHANGELOG.md. Enforcement is now ARMED (a2a-nexus#1501 item 1c): the CHANGELOG `## Unreleased` section has been backfilled with the real post-alpha public-safe changes, so the gate is live and green together. With `armed:true` the gate fails closed if `## Unreleased` is ever reset to an empty placeholder while a released version exists — keeping the changelog honest as new public changes land before the next tag.

enforcement.armedRationale: Armed in a2a-nexus#1501 item 1c together with the CHANGELOG ## Unreleased backfill.
